sourceDisplay: Unique Business Identifier of the CareSet
targetDisplay: Business Identifier(s) relevant for this EpisodeOfCare

sourceDisplay: The person who is the subject of the healthcare to which the record refers
targetDisplay: The patient who is the focus of this episode of care

sourceDisplay: Recording date by the Author or Recorder (date of last update)
comment: R4 EpisodeOfCare has no recorded date; carried by the be-core extension be-ext-recorded-date (context DomainResource), constrained to 1..1.

R4 EpisodeOfCare has no creation date, and it cannot share be-ext-recorded-date: two occurrences of the same extension would be indistinguishable, while RecordedDate is the last update and Creation date the first registration. Carried by the be-core extension be-ext-creation-date (context DomainResource), constrained to 1..1.

targetDisplay: planned | waitlist | active | onhold | finished | cancelled | entered-in-error
comment: R4 required binding on EpisodeOfCare.status is kept. VS_Status_EpisodeOfCare in the CareSet lists only active, onhold, finished and entered-in-error, while the business rules also refer to Cancelled - the R4 value set is wider.

sourceDisplay: The healthcare professional who takes responsibility for the recorded content
comment: R4 EpisodeOfCare has no author/recorder element; carried by the be-core extension be-ext-recorder.

sourceDisplay: The period between the moment the resource is created to group the provided care and the moment it ends
comment: Constrained to 1..1 per CareSet V0.8. Business rules: period.start is required when status is active; period.end is required when status is finished or cancelled - not expressed as an invariant yet.

sourceDisplay: The problem treated during the EpisodeOfCare
targetDisplay: The list of diagnosis relevant to this episode of care
comment: R4 EpisodeOfCare has no reason element; the problem is carried by diagnosis.condition, constrained to 1..1 Reference(BeProblem) per CareSet V0.8.

sourceDisplay: The problem treated during the EpisodeOfCare - coded form
comment: be-ext-codeableconcept has context Element, so it can codify the reference itself: the problem can be sent as a code (VS_Encounter_Reason - the business case uses SNOMED 44054006) when no BeProblem resource is referenced.
R4 EpisodeOfCare has no note element; carried by the be-core extension be-ext-simple-note.

sourceDisplay: Organization responsible for the management and coordination of the patient's EpisodeOfCare
comment: CareSet says 0..*; R4 EpisodeOfCare.managingOrganization is 0..1 and cannot be repeated. Constrained to Reference(BeOrganization).

sourceDisplay: CareTeam involved in the care carried out within this EpisodeOfCare
targetDisplay: Other practitioners facilitating this episode of care
comment: New in CareSet V0.8. Targets the base CareTeam resource - there is no BeCareTeam in be-core (one exists in patient-dossier).
